extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and practitioners filing with the USPTO (applicants/attorneys/agents)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for where, when, and how applicants should request and participate in interviews with USPTO examiners (including in-person and WebEx/video conferences), and what procedural prerequisites and limitations apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner discretion per MPEP 713
rubrics_metrics.description: The policies for determining whether it is appropriate to hold an interview are included in MPEP 713. The examiner determines whether to grant an interview request per MPEP 713.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference MPEP 713 for the detailed policy and factors; ultimately the examiner decides whether an interview is appropriate. This is the governing policy for interview appropriateness and grant/denial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Normal business hours for interviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Interviews should to be held during normal business hours (i.e. Monday-Friday 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM) or at a mutually agreed upon time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule interviews during USPTO business hours when possible; exceptions may be made if both parties mutually agree to another time.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-person interview location requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All in-person interviews must be held on a USPTO campus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should not expect in-person interviews to occur off-campus; plan travel to a USPTO facility if an in-person meeting is requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant interview requests normally granted if appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant’s request for an interview, if appropriate, is normally granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the examiner has discretion per MPEP 713, the general practice is to grant appropriate interview requests. ‘Appropriate’ follows the MPEP criteria referenced above.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video conferencing availability and WebEx use
rubrics_metrics.description: Video conferencing is available for interviews. Interviews held via video conference will use WebEx. Requests for video conferencing will normally be granted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may request a WebEx interview; such requests are generally accommodated. Expect WebEx as the standard platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: USPTO-hosted video conferences only
rubrics_metrics.description: All interviews using video conferencing must be hosted by the USPTO. Examiners are not permitted to join video conferences originating outside the USPTO. Examiners will establish the WebEx session for an interview and send invitations to all other parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not propose using an externally hosted video meeting; the examiner will create and distribute the WebEx invitation. This ensures security and procedural compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written applicant authorization required for internet communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Before a video conference interview can be scheduled, written authorization from the applicant for communications via the internet is required. [MPEP 502.03]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain and provide the required written authorization (per MPEP 502.03) before the USPTO will schedule a WebEx interview. This is a precondition to using internet-based communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner physical location not limiting
rubrics_metrics.description: The physical location of the examiner does not limit the ability to conduct an interview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners working remotely may still conduct interviews (via USPTO-hosted WebEx or from USPTO facilities); applicants should not assume interviews require the examiner to be physically local.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public interview rooms availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Public interview rooms are available on the USPTO campus in Alexandria and Detroit for applicants to participate in a video conference with an examiner working remotely. The examiner will reserve the public interview room for the applicant using an online reservation system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an applicant lacks facilities for WebEx participation, they can use USPTO public interview rooms in specified locations; examiners will handle reservation for the applicant via the USPTO system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agenda may be requested but not required to grant interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiners may request an agenda to facilitate a focus discussion of the issues. However, the absence of an agenda alone usually is not a proper basis to deny an interview request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing an agenda can help focus the interview and may be requested by the examiner, but not having one should not, by itself, prevent the interview from being granted.
